text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season arrived once again this year.
Kawakami Princess was—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"One, two, three, four.
One, two, phew~."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I'm ready for whatever training you can throw at me!
choice_data_list: You're full of motivation, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I got a full night of sleep beforehand!
And I haven't forgotten a single thing!

She had grown so much more compared to last summer.
And surely, once we make it through this summer too...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be sure to leave everyone in the dust
at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup♪"
She's bound to grow even more.
